sources.title: Transport planning and policy
sources.verified_claim: Enfield's Transport Plan sets long-term priorities for active travel, public transport accessibility and reduced private-vehicle impacts; this is network strategy rather than parcel-specific connectivity evidence.

sources.title: Road works
sources.verified_claim: Enfield coordinates road and utility works to maintain transport reliability and reduce disruption as the borough grows; current works can affect delivery timing but require location-specific checking.

sources.title: Transport Strategy
sources.verified_claim: Lambeth's Transport Strategy links mobility, accessibility, public health and the environment to future population growth and network change, supported by a project map and implementation plan.

sources.title: Our strategy
sources.verified_claim: Lambeth states its transport network should help deliver more homes and jobs while prioritising walking, cycling, accessibility and long-term sustainability.

sources.title: Delivering the Transport Strategy
sources.verified_claim: Lambeth's Transport Strategy Implementation Plan contains planned and considered projects and is intended to be updated regularly; programme inclusion does not establish delivery at a sample parcel.

sources.title: The Lambeth Kerbside Strategy
sources.verified_claim: Lambeth reports more than 64 km of kerbside space reallocated for sustainable uses since the 2023 strategy, including cycling, EV, greening and public-space interventions; this is borough delivery context.

sources.title: Mayor of London and London Councils unveil new London Infrastructure Framework to drive growth
sources.verified_claim: City Hall says the 2026 London Infrastructure Framework identifies 51 priority projects across transport, energy, waste, water, flood risk and digital connectivity to support housing, jobs and resilience.

sources.title: ADD2787 Infrastructure Coordination Service Programme
sources.verified_claim: The Infrastructure Coordination Service programme records utility-company participation, developer guidance for energy-capacity constraint areas, SuDS-streetworks work and integrated water-management milestones; these are system-level enablers, not parcel capacity confirmation.
